info.title: NetSentry API
info.description: Implemented account, workspace, device enrolment/lifecycle, health/capability reporting and privacy APIs. Measurement ingestion, router actions and service-command execution remain future contracts. POST endpoints retain 201 defaults. Direct device registration is disabled in favor of explicit enrolment.

servers.description: Local default; deployment prefix/base URL is configurable.

post.description: Direct registration is disabled. Use one-time code issuance and /devices/enrol. Existing records remain UNVERIFIED until explicitly enrolled.
